project_comments.note: Cross-cutting technical debt identified across WP-001..WP-004: (1) The $caseSensitive parameter in _translateContains() and _translateSearch() in both HubL and Velocity AbstractIfBase classes is semantically inverted — it carries isCaseInsensitive() = true meaning case-insensitive. Both classes share this quirk. A dedicated cleanup ticket should rename to $caseInsensitive across all four call-sites and both implementations simultaneously to eliminate the persistent mental inversion tax. (2) TimezoneInterface lacks hasExplicitTimezone() — the workaround of inspecting getInfo()->getTokenByParamName() is correct but fragile. Adding hasExplicitTimezone() to the interface and implementing it via the same introspection would encapsulate the pattern and prevent future mis-implementations. (3) The renderEncodings() contract (must be applied to the INNER expression, never the full {{ }} wrapper) is undocumented at the base class level. A one-line @note in BaseHubLCommandTranslation::renderEncodings() would prevent the wrapping-order trap for future translators.
